ca_western_sierra.name: Western Sierra
ca_western_sierra.note: MP: lower crags best fall-winter-spring, high domes summer-early fall; spans elevations, no months named, no single season.

or_madrone_wall.name: Madrone Wall
or_madrone_wall.note: Only a falcon closure (Feb 1-Jul 15) found; an access rule, not a season.

az_west_stronghold.name: West Stronghold
az_west_stronghold.note: Stronghold-wide: MP says spring and fall best, winter good on most days, summer only for the heat-tolerant; bouldering guide names Oct-Apr. Raptor closures Mar-Jun on some domes.

co_long_s_peak.name: Long's Peak
co_long_s_peak.note: SummitPost: early July to mid-Sept, July/Aug peak; NPS: summer climbing, otherwise winter conditions; snow can linger to late July. Alpine summer season.

me_shagg_crag.name: Shagg Crag
me_shagg_crag.note: Sources conflict (fall vs late spring-early fall), no months named; falcon nesting closures.

az_munchkinland_area.name: Munchkinland Area
az_munchkinland_area.note: MP: season roughly April to October, chase sun/shade; blog agrees; cools off quickly toward winter. Troll Wall page says March-early Nov.

co_palace_the_2.name: Palace, The
co_palace_the_2.note: Only general late spring-early fall wording from a bouldering guide; no month-naming source.

ga_palisades_the.name: Palisades, The
ga_palisades_the.note: REI: near year-round; summer harder; no months named.

pa_lost_crag_the.name: Lost Crag, The
pa_lost_crag_the.note: Page titled closed to climbing; no season found.

ut_black_rocks.name: Black Rocks
ut_black_rocks.note: One site says Jan-Oct, another fall-spring and too hot Jul-Aug; reported Mar 15-Jun 30 closure; contradictory.

co_north_rim_routes.name: North Rim Routes
co_north_rim_routes.note: NPS: peak windows mid-April to early June and mid-Sept to early Nov; other park sites similar; hot summers slow climbing; North Rim Road opens mid-April.

nv_lower_canyon.name: Lower Canyon
nv_lower_canyon.note: Fall, winter, spring best and hot ~six months, but no months named.

or_main_area_boulders.name: Main Area Boulders
or_main_area_boulders.note: Only forum opinions (spring/April, fall); no month-naming source.

ca_mountaineer_walls.name: Mountaineer Walls
ca_mountaineer_walls.note: The Toe is south-facing, good in winter, raptor restrictions; no months.

co_beige_tube_area_the_narrows.name: Beige Tube Area / The Narrows
co_beige_tube_area_the_narrows.note: Only vague spring-through-fall; ice is separate.

nc_cedar_rock.name: Cedar Rock
nc_cedar_rock.note: Aggregator says spring and fall; no month-naming source.

nh_wm_pinkham_presidentials.name: Pinkham / Presidentials
nh_wm_pinkham_presidentials.note: Summer-early fall rock, late fall-spring ice; no months named for rock; Cannon often not good until May.

nm_dona_ana_mountains.name: Dona Ana Mountains
nm_dona_ana_mountains.note: Nothing specific found; hiking pages say winter/spring.
